callouts.html: Billing through 2026-06-30. Calendar H1 is €1.37m vs €1.06m (+29.2%). Commercial in that window is +34.9%. Credit notes are not sales.
Q1 billing is +8.3% (€771k vs €712k). H1 is milder at +29.2% — later months recovered some of the hole. There is no official sales cut on file for this distributor.
Warranty is 21.7% of calendar 2025 billed euro — not the majority of the book. Commercial 2023→2025 is +9.3% (€1.52m → €1.68m → €1.66m).
July this year is not in the billing file yet, so July cannot be split. Do not read an official July miss from this pack.

aim.note: Catalogue family is PR00 group on the parts catalogue. 99.8% of Calendar 2025 commercial euros have a family name. The clustered bars name families from the selected window (at least €4,000 in either year, or 3% of the window). Other is unclassified plus families below that cut — not every classified euro. No Shell lubricant lines in this book, so Shell is not on the chart. On Calendar 2025 with warranty hidden, Other is 7,923 € (0%): Unclassified €3,760, Consumables €3,105, Belts €1,058.
